---
name: Research evidence correction
about: Report a possible error, inconsistency, reproducibility issue, or evidence problem
title: "[Evidence correction] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Affected claim or artefact

Identify the exact claim, file, evidence record, repository path, commit, or
release affected.

## Description of the issue

Describe the suspected error or inconsistency clearly.

## Supporting evidence

Provide the commands, outputs, source material, hashes, references, or other
evidence supporting the report.

## Expected interpretation

Explain what you believe the record or result should show.

## Scientific impact

State whether this appears to affect:

- a reported verification result;
- an assumption or domain;
- provenance;
- reproducibility;
- a thesis claim;
- a repository locator or checksum;
- documentation only; or
- another aspect of the research record.

## Historical evidence

State whether the issue concerns a frozen or historical artefact.

Historical evidence should not be silently rewritten. Where appropriate,
propose an auditable correction or superseding record instead.

## Third-party material

State whether third-party or upstream material is involved.

## Security sensitivity

Do not include credentials, secrets, private keys, access tokens, or
unpublished vulnerability details here.

For security-sensitive matters, follow `SECURITY.md`.
